review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "Kan jeg få …?" is the polite request; "kom inn" is the imperative of "komme".

sentences.text: Det er lørdag. Sam besøker Marta.
sentences.english: It is Saturday. Sam is visiting Marta.

sentences.text: Marta bor i et lite hus i byen. Sam kommer til huset. Han er glad.
sentences.english: Marta lives in a small house in town. Sam comes to the house. He is happy.

sentences.text: God dag, Marta! Kan jeg komme inn?
sentences.english: Hello, Marta! Can I come in?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Hei, Sam! Ja, kom inn!
sentences.english: Hi, Sam! Yes, come in!
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Vær så god! Du kan sitte her.
sentences.english: Please! You can sit here.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Takk. Du har en stor stue, Marta.
sentences.english: Thanks. You have a big living room, Marta.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, stua er stor. Huset er lite.
sentences.english: Yes, the living room is big. The house is small.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg lager kaffe. Vil du ha kaffe?
sentences.english: I am making coffee. Do you want coffee?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nei takk. Kan jeg få te?
sentences.english: No thanks. Can I have tea?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, du får te. Vil du ha melk i teen?
sentences.english: Yes, you get tea. Do you want milk in the tea?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne. Litt melk, takk.
sentences.english: Yes, please. A little milk, please.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Her er te. Her er melk.
sentences.english: Here is tea. Here is milk.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Sam sitter her. Han drikker te. Teen er god.
sentences.english: Sam sits here. He drinks tea. The tea is good.

sentences.text: Teen er god, Marta. Du er snill.
sentences.english: The tea is good, Marta. You are kind.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Nei, nei. Du er snill, Sam. Du besøker meg hver lørdag.
sentences.english: No, no. You are kind, Sam. You visit me every Saturday.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nils kommer inn i stua. Han er sulten.
sentences.english: Nils comes into the living room. He is hungry.

sentences.text: Hei, Sam! Er du på besøk?
sentences.english: Hi, Sam! Are you visiting?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, jeg er hos bestemora di.
sentences.english: Yes, I am at your grandmother's.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bestemor, får jeg brød?
sentences.english: Grandmother, may I have bread?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, her er brød med ost. Du er snill, Nils.
sentences.english: Yes, here is bread with cheese. You are kind, Nils.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nils sitter og spiser brød med ost.
sentences.english: Nils sits and eats bread with cheese.

sentences.text: Jeg vil ha melk også.
sentences.english: I want milk too.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Her er melk.
sentences.english: Here is milk.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Marta er glad.
sentences.english: Marta is happy.

sentences.text: Kom hver lørdag, Sam! Du er alltid glad i kirka.
sentences.english: Come every Saturday, Sam! You are always happy at church.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Takk, Marta! Jeg kommer gjerne.
sentences.english: Thank you, Marta! I will gladly come.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jobben til Marta er å bake brød. Anna er sykepleier, og hun hjelper pasientene.
sentences.english: Marta's job is to bake bread. Anna is a nurse, and she helps the patients.

sentences.text: Unnskyld, hvor er busstoppet?
sentences.english: Excuse me, where is the bus stop?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Gå rett fram, og så til høyre. Så er du i sentrum.
sentences.english: Go straight ahead, and then to the right. Then you are in the town centre.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Du har en lang uke, Sam. På mandag og tirsdag er du på skolen.
sentences.english: You have a long week, Sam. On Monday and Tuesday you are at school.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: På onsdag og torsdag er du hjemme, og på fredag er du i sentrum.
sentences.english: On Wednesday and Thursday you are at home, and on Friday you are in the town centre.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Det regner, og været er vått. Anna har paraply.
sentences.english: It is raining, and the weather is wet. Anna has an umbrella.
